description: Source code for the OCDM plugin implementation in WPEFramework, including memory observation, initialization, deinitialization, and request processing.

classes.name: MemoryObserverImpl
classes.description: Implementation of Exchange::IMemory that observes remote process memory usage.

methods.name: MemoryObserver
methods.description: Creates a memory observer for a given remote connection.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the OCDM plugin, sets up content decryption, and memory observation.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters notifications, and releases connections.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information; currently no additional info.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming web requests; currently empty.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes web requests for OCDM, returning system info, sessions, or designators.
